animations.scroll: Use Framer Motion for fade-in-up on scroll for all sections. Stagger children in grids.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images has a dark gradient overlay or backdrop blur. Strictly follow minimum contrast ratios.

specific_instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page scrolling architecture with sections: Hero, About, Spaces, Events, Amenities, Gallery, Pricing, Booking, Contact.
Import Cormorant Garamond and Outfit fonts from Google Fonts in index.css.
Implement a bilingual toggle (DE/EN) in the header. Use standard React state or a lightweight context to swap text strings.

Use 'react-fast-marquee' for the Event Occasions section to create an 'Editorial Ribbon' of text (e.g. 'Corporate Events • Photo Shoots • Offsite Meetings • Film Production'). Make it slow and subtle.
Forms: Use Shadcn UI for the Booking form, including a Date/Time picker (Calendar). Make the inputs minimalist (border-b only or very subtle full borders, rounded-none).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and form inputs (e.g., 'data-testid="nav-booking-link"').
Images must be large and editorial. Maximize negative space. Do not cram elements together. Use bento-style layouts where appropriate.
Override any default Shadcn 'rounded-md' to 'rounded-none' to enforce the sharp, brutalist/editorial aesthetic.
The maximum capacity is 50 seated / 60 standing, and total space is approx. 260 sqm. Mention these prominently in the Amenities or About section.
Ensure 'No birthday or bachelor party bookings' is clearly stated in the pricing or booking section.
For the Spaces section, use the 'Tetris Grid' pattern: a bento-style layout mixing wide and square images overlapping with descriptions.
For the Location Map in Contact section, embed an OpenStreetMap iframe pointing to Düsseldorf Friedrichstadt, customized with a greyscale filter via CSS if possible, or use a placeholder map block.
